title: Woman disguises 911 call by ordering pizza
summary: A local news report about a woman who ordered a pizza on a 911 call to discreetly signal domestic violence and give her address to the dispatcher. The coverage includes the actual dispatcher call.
why: Cited as a real example of coded language used to get help in emergency calls without alerting an abuser.

quote.text: someone dialed 911 and proceeded to "order a pizza," thus giving them her address.
